On a hectic finish, rules for the planning team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

The purpose of this section is to guide the desk in handling companion animal travel with care, consistency, and calm judgment. Staff must confirm travel details with courtesy, keep records accurate, and protect the comfort of each animal and passenger throughout the journey. When a request is opened, the team should review the booking, the carrier, and any health or handling notes before confirming acceptance. <<FACT F078>> The desk must never promise carriage until all required checks are complete and any limits from the operator have been reviewed.

The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, keeping them upright, secure, and away from rough handling. If a passenger appears worried, staff should listen patiently, speak in plain language, and offer clear next steps without rushing the conversation. When a case involves a reptile, the desk must follow the relevant age rule, check all supporting documents, and ensure the animal meets every condition before travel is approved. If any required item is missing, the desk must pause the process and advise the passenger what is still needed. Staff may also arrange special note placement for the senior coordinator so that loading staff understand any quiet, temperature, or transfer concern.

The desk must treat every animal as a live responsibility, not as baggage, and must reject any request that cannot be managed safely. Carriers should remain sealed only when policy allows, and any welfare concern reported by the ground team must be passed upward at once. Where a passenger such as Leo Schneider or Leila Park asks for reassurance, the reply should remain respectful, direct, and reassuring. Poppy, if booked for travel, should be handled under the same standard of care as any other pet.

Records must be complete, legible, and updated before handover. The team should verify contact details, special instructions, and acceptance notes so that the next service has a clear record.

For any uncertain case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
